semiconductor_relevance: High — Kyodo International specializes in nano lithography technology, which is critical for producing nanoscale patterns used in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Kyodo International develops advanced nano lithography tools designed for both research and volume production of nanoscale photonic patterns. Their equipment facilitates the creation of grating patterns for waveguides, essential in various semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Nano lithography tools for periodic photonic patterns
Automatic cassette operation for volume production
Step & Repeat lithography for larger areas
Manual operation tools for R&D and small volume production
